rows.required_observation: - **FR-064 Stable remote installation:** supported macOS/Linux users MUST be able to install from one stable remote bootstrap command without cloning the repository or building from source. The canonical versioned bootstrap source MUST be `scripts/install.sh` in this repository, consumed through the repository's stable raw URL. The bootstrap MUST detect the supported OS/architecture, resolve one published release under the release-selection policy below, select the matching published artifact, verify integrity before installation and install only into an owned safe destination. Release-selection and version policy (Issue #81): - published versions use SemVer-compatible tags: stable `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` (published with `prerelease=false`) and release candidate `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-rc.N` (published with `prerelease=true`); draft releases are never installable; - with no selector, and with the explicitly equivalent `--channel stable`, the bootstrap installs the latest published stable release. It MUST NOT silently fall back to a release candidate; when no stable release exists it fails explicitly with zero installation effects and directs the operator to `--version <tag>`; - `--version <tag>` resolves exactly that published stable or RC tag and never floats to a newer release.
